content.title: Pigment-Trail Dance | Body Motion Builds Persistent Fluid Marks
content.summary: A calligrapher's staff motion accumulates into a wind-map mural. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: The first visible contact creates the trail. + The performer remains the sole motion source. + Every new strand extends an existing path. + Color additions follow distinct contacts. + The terminal artwork preserves the accumulated movement history.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lower one adult calligrapher's boot onto a blank plaster floor and create a single cobalt pigment pool. Each staff sweep extends that existing ribbon without spawning disconnected marks. Let the person stop while all accumulated strands settle into an original wind-map mural.
